focal_point: Two magenta circles over a technician and a water heater. The larger circle is the deal.
scale_ratios: Headline is large. The bigger circle is the offer and overlaps a second, smaller deal.
type_choices: One sans, about five sizes. White on magenta is clearest.
photo_art_direction: In-home technician beside the equipment, direct gaze. Tank labels add noise.
offer_placement: Overlapping circles. Two discounts fight and cover the person.
trust_and_cta: Phone and URL under the mark. No code.

gestalt.reason: Circles should be one group and are two.

photo.reason: Person plus product, gaze at camera.

emulate: A curved edge between copy and a person-plus-product photo. One price circle.
anti_patterns: Two sticker prices on one body
summary: Mailbox water-treatment card. The split is fast. Two circles split the offer.
